audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 were given to K'Sante on both layers while the whys beside them read 'Level 2 stays even' and 'Level 3 remains a skill matchup'.
audit.why: Neither champion has a committal tool at those levels; K'Sante's W is his only lockdown and Zaahen has a dash out of it. The packet levelChart and the audited mirror both mark rows 0-4 Skill.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 set to Skill on both layers; ratings were already 5/10 and needed no change.

audit.whatIsWrong: All Out was described as making him 'a low-resist, high-damage duelist' with no cooldown and, crucially, with the wrong conclusion — the page tells you to avoid him in All Out.
audit.why: All Out is 120/100/80 and Riot's text is explicit that it comes 'at the cost of reduced defenses'. It also removes the knock-back and stun from Path Maker. So All Out is the window where he has no hard CC and the least armour — the moment to commit, not to run, provided you carry Grievous Wounds against the healing it grants.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d rewritten to point the all-in at his All Out window with the 120s figure attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ntofo Strikes was called a stun in three places. It is not. Path Maker's true damage and the anti-heal requirement were absent entirely.
audit.why: Riot's text: Ntofo Strikes grants a stack on hit and 'at 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in' — a pull, on a 3.5s cooldown at 450 range. Path Maker carries the trueDamage flag and reduces damage taken during its charge-up, so building armour reads that trade wrong. All Out grants healing, which is the flagged anti-heal case.
audit.corrected: Pull corrected in spikes[2].text, wants.foe[0] and dontsFull[0].d; true damage written into dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns; Grievous Wounds added to spikes[2].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'late' field says the 55% win rate is K'Sante's. It is Zaahen's: 55.02% over 1425 games.
audit.why: A reader told the enemy wins 55% of this lane will play it as a losing matchup and give up the even early levels the number is actually built on.
audit.corrected: Rewrote 'late' so the 55% is attributed to you and located in the early levels where you bank it.

edits.before: Once K'Sante hits his first bruiser item and beyond he tilts the matchup — All Out shreds your armor and his stun-plus-dash combo out-duels you, which is why his 55% win rate lives in the item phases. Pivot to side-lane split pressure with your Q and keep R up for his engage; don't try to out-brawl him in his All Out window.
edits.after: Once K'Sante hits his first bruiser item he tilts the lane — All Out heals him while it shreds you and the pull-plus-dash combo out-duels you — but the 55% overall win rate is yours, banked in the even early levels. Pivot to side-lane pressure with your Q, keep R for his engage, and buy Grievous Wounds before you contest him.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. Combo when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - All Out: 120s at rank 1, and it cuts his own resistances — fight him in it, not before it. - Path Maker: 14s, true damage, so armour does not read that trade. - Ntofo Strikes is 3.5s: the second stack pulls.

edits.before: His duelist mode. Combo when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: In All Out he loses the W stun and his own resistances — fight him there.

edits.before: That is K'Sante's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two Ntofo Strikes fire a shockwave that pulls you in — break the 3.5s chain.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: Path Maker's charge-up cuts the damage he takes and it lands true damage — armour will not save you.

edits.before: K'Sante's R All Out is the pivot: he reforms into a low-resist, high-damage duelist and can Q knock-up plus R dash you under his tower. Don't sit in melee range at 6 without your R Final Retribution or Flash available, because his ult combo chunks half your bar and repositions you into his jungler.
edits.after: All Out (120s at rank 1) is the pivot: R knocks you back through walls, then he dashes after with more damage, healing, and far lower resistances. That last part is the opening — his W stops stunning while he is All Out, so once he commits it your E and R burst a target with no resistances left.

edits.before: He spikes hard into Sunfire/Heartsteel bruiser items — his Ntofo Strikes (Q) stun off two hits becomes a reliable lock, and All Out shreds your armor. This is his strongest window; play for CS and let your own item come online rather than forcing a duel.
edits.after: He spikes into Sunfire/Heartsteel bruiser items — two Ntofo Strikes on a 3.5s cooldown fire a shockwave that pulls you in, and All Out heals him as it shreds you, so bring Grievous Wounds. This is his strongest window; farm and let your own item land.

edits.before: Land Ntofo Strikes (Q) twice to stun you into an All Out combo
edits.after: Land Ntofo Strikes twice so the shockwave pulls you into his combo

edits.before: Use W to tank a trade and reset his passive autos on you
edits.after: Charge W to blunt your burst, then stun you with true damage

edits.before: Save R Final Retribution and Flash for his level-6 All Out engage
edits.after: Save your R and Flash for his level-6 All Out engage at 120s

notes: K'Sante's passive Dauntless Instinct marks a target from his abilities so the next attack hits harder — the flagged auto-reset tell. Every field that could have carried it was already at its length ceiling with the pull correction or the All Out correction, both higher value, so it is recorded here rather than forced in. Zaahen's own ability names remain unverifiable from his kit file; slot letters used instead of the content layer's 'Darkin Glaive' / 'Final Retribution'.
